rows:
본교 입학 이전에 타교 대학원에서 취득한 학점을 인정받고자 하는 대학원생.
※ 원활한 학사운영을 위해 입학 첫 학기에 신청 바랍니다.
※ 자세한 사항은 첨부파일(붙임01) 참고.

가. 기간: ~ 2026. 9. 21.(월) 오후 5시까지
나. 신청서류를 학부행정실(301동 319호) 담당자에게 제출
다. 신청서류: 1) ~ 4) 서류 모두 제출
1) 첨부파일(붙임02, 붙임03)
※ 붙임02: 본인 서명, 지도교수 서명(또는 날인) 필수
※ 붙임03: 학과(부)장 공란
2) 전적대학 성적증명서
※ 외국대학의 경우 ①영문 성적증명서
②강의시간을 확인할 수 있는 증빙자료(시간표, 이수시간 산출 내역 등)
3) 동일전공임을 확인할 수 있는 서류: 강의계획서, 전공 개요·교과목 개요 (핵심적인 부분만 제출)
4) 전적대학 소속 증빙서류: 수료증명서 또는 재적증명서 등

original.text: 가. 본교 석사·박사과정 입학 이전에 타교 동일과정 동일·유사 전공의 석사·박사과정에서 취득한
교과학점은 성적이 B0이상이며 10년 이내에 이수한 동일·유사 교과목에 한하여
석사과정 6학점, 박사과정 9학점, 석사·박사통합과정 15학점까지 이수학점으로 인정할 수 있음.
나. 다만, 입학 전 타교 석사·박사통합과정에서 학점을 취득하고
본교 석사과정으로 입학할 경우 6학점까지 인정할 수 있음.
1) 지도교수 추천 → 학부 학사위원회 → 단과대학 학사위원회 → 총장 승인.
2) 학점 인정을 승인받은 교과목은 본교의 동일‧유사한 교과목을 이수한 것으로
학적부에 등재하되, 성적은 평점 평균 산출 시에는 산입하지 않음.
라. ‘타교 대학원 수학학점 인정’ 받은 경우, 본교에서 동일‧유사 교과목을 다시 수강하지 못함.

english:
Graduate students who want credits they earned at another university's graduate school, before entering SNU, to be recognized.
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester after admission.
※ For details, see the attached file (Attachment 01).

A. Deadline: by 21 Sep 2026 (Mon), 5 p.m.
B. Submit the application documents to the staff member in charge at the Department Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319).
C. Application documents: submit all documents 1) to 4)
1) Attached files (Attachment 02, Attachment 03)
※ Attachment 02: your own signature and your academic advisor's signature (or seal) are required.
※ Attachment 03: leave the Department Chair section blank.
2) Transcript from your previous university
※ For foreign universities: ① an English transcript
② supporting documents that show the class hours (timetable, breakdown of completed hours, etc.)
3) Documents showing that the major is the same: course syllabus, major overview and course overview (submit only the key parts)
4) Proof of enrollment at your previous university: certificate of completion (수료증명서) or certificate of enrollment record (재적증명서), etc.
A. Course credits earned in a master's or doctoral program in the same or a similar major, at the same degree level, at another university before entering a master's or doctoral program at SNU,
can be recognized only for the same or similar courses with a grade of B0 or higher that were completed within the last 10 years,
up to 6 credits for a master's program, 9 credits for a doctoral program, and 15 credits for an integrated master's-doctoral program, as completed credits.
B. However, if you earned credits in an integrated master's-doctoral program at another university before admission
and entered a master's program at SNU, up to 6 credits can be recognized.
1) Recommendation by your academic advisor → Department Academic Affairs Committee → College Academic Affairs Committee → approval by the President.
2) Courses approved for credit recognition are recorded in your academic record (학적부) as completion of the same or similar SNU courses,
but their grades are not included when calculating your grade point average (GPA).
D. If you have received 'recognition of credits earned at another graduate school', you cannot take the same or similar courses again at SNU.
- Please refer to the attached files.
- Contact: Department Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319) / 박한수 (Park Han-su) / hansoopark@snu.ac.kr
